mission: Unify books, movies, video, websites, games, game playing, and game building into one benchmarkable learning graph.
benchmark_rule: Every media capability requires source tasks, original variants, cross-domain transfer, failure recovery, and regression tests.
copyright_rule: Use authorized/open/user-provided material. Learn concepts and observable structure; do not reproduce protected books, films, games, websites, assets, characters, stories, maps, or code without permission.
cost_rule: Free/local/open tools first. Paid models require explicit approval.
